description: This file declares the interface for 'ucode' support in the wpa_supplicant, including initialization, cleanup, event handling, and BSS management functions. It conditionally includes real implementations or inline stubs based on UCODE_SUPPORT macro.

methods.name: int wpas_ucode_init(struct wpa_global * gl)
methods.description: Initializes the ucode subsystem with the given global context.

methods.name: void wpas_ucode_free(void)
methods.description: Frees resources allocated by the ucode subsystem.

methods.name: void wpas_ucode_add_bss(struct wpa_supplicant * wpa_s)
methods.description: Adds a BSS entry to the ucode management for a given wpa_supplicant instance.

methods.name: void wpas_ucode_free_bss(struct wpa_supplicant * wpa_s)
methods.description: Removes a BSS entry from ucode management.

methods.name: void wpas_ucode_update_state(struct wpa_supplicant * wpa_s)
methods.description: Updates the ucode state based on the current wpa_supplicant state.

methods.name: void wpas_ucode_event(struct wpa_supplicant * wpa_s,int event,union wpa_event_data * data)
methods.description: Handles wpa_supplicant events within ucode context.

methods.name: void wpas_ucode_ctrl_event(struct wpa_supplicant * wpa_s,const char * str,size_t len)
methods.description: Handles control string events for ucode.

methods.name: bool wpas_ucode_bss_allowed(struct wpa_supplicant * wpa_s,struct wpa_bss * bss)
methods.description: Checks if a BSS is allowed in the current ucode context.

methods.name: void wpas_ucode_wps_complete(struct wpa_supplicant * wpa_s,const struct wps_credential * cred)
methods.description: Called when WPS process completes with provided credentials.
